message.title: Solstad Maritime ASA - Contract awards for CSV Normand Australis
message.body:
Skudeneshavn, 30 October 2026

Solstad Maritime ASA ("SOMA") is pleased to announce that it has been awarded
two firm contracts for the CSV Normand Australis in the Asia Pacific region.

The contracts will be performed in direct continuation of each other and has a
combined firm duration of 250 days. Work is expected to commence in December
2026, and the contracts include a combined 75 days of options beyond the firm
periods.

The combined value of the firm contracts is Substantial, which SOMA defines as
contracts with value between USD 10 and 30 million. The firm contract value is
estimated at the lower end of this interval.

Under the contracts, the vessel will perform ROV- and subsea support activities.

Contacts:
